from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Start date: 2006-01-27 (Friday)
start_date = datetime(2006, 1, 27)
print(f"Start date: {start_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} ({start_date.strftime('%A')})")

# Add 986 days
end_date = start_date + timedelta(days=986)
print(f"End date (986 days later): {end_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} ({end_date.strftime('%A')})")

# Get the day of the week name
day_of_week = end_date.strftime('%A')
print(f"\nDay of the week: {day_of_week}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
